case.summary: Verdict: uncertain — the evidence points toward card-not-present fraud from a new device (pattern 3) on card C08106-K1, but falls just short of confirmation. The window shows eight online transactions totaling $384.43 between 2016-12-28 and 2016-12-30, with several flagged `New` on the identity record (id_15), including txn 3583227 ($128.33, risk 0.34) and txn 3585446 ($83.87, from device profile HUAWEI VNS-L23), amounts above the customer's historical mean of $32.51. The customer's history is exclusively online product C in region 284, and prior cases CC-3778, CC-1736, and CC-2121 confirm this same card has been compromised three times before. However, the heuristic probability is 0.68 (below the 0.70 threshold of R1), and the customer's all-online history makes the channel itself unremarkable. Recommended action: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER (auto) before any block, with MONITOR_CARD on C08106-K1 pending the reply; escalate to an analyst if the customer denies the activity.
